General distribution and ecology: Staurastrum cyclacanthum var. brevissimum and S. c. var. dissimile were described by Palmar-Mordviencev (1982) from lake waters in Ukraine. Nominal taxon S. c. var. cyclacantum W. et G. S. West was described from lakes in the lake area of Western Europe. The occurrence of the S. c. var. cyclacantum W. et G. S. West in New Zealand was confirmed by Casdale, Flint (1988). The authors also report its occurrence in Sri Lanka and South America. The source literature on the ecology of the nominal taxon and its varieties does not contain detailed information on the habitat parameters of the species.
